create_meta_annotator: create a MetaAnnotator instance to write annotations for a pydipcc game as it's being generated
add_annotation_to_game: add an annotation with encoded data, tag, phase, and timestamp to the MetaAnnotator records
commit_annotations_to_file: commit accumulated annotation records to the output file and clear the internal buffer
read_raw_records_from_file: read RawRecord annotations from a file and clean up inconsistent annotations produced due to requeue
handle_new_phase_transition: call after_new_phase on the MetaAnnotator when the game has stepped to a new phase
